name: Ramp
description: Enables secure, read-only access to Ramp data for customer-defined logic. Supports loading and querying transactions, reimbursements, bills, purchase orders, cards, vendors, and more, enabling dynamic data fetching and analysis via Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ramp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ramp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ramp-mcp-remote.ramp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ramp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ramp lists 17 MCP tools, including execute_query, clear_table, load_spend_export, load_spend_exports, load_purchase_orders, load_cards, load_limits, load_entities, load_departments, load_users, load_memos, and load_locations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ramp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ramp in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Ramp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ramp is developed by Ramp. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
